Players Committee card image of [[Corellia (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' Your Corellians and freighters deploy -1 here. Your starships are hyperspeed +1 when moving to or from here.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/corellia.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/corellia.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
